_README: Written by io_model_v4.py. Every figure PROVISIONAL pending the Physics Validator's check of the v4 re-run (R-38). Primary energy, LHV, as the Danish energy account records it; kWh/cap/yr at 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ; Denmark 2023.

A.definition: delivered electricity (all industries) x PEF_ref / cumulative primary of this construction (Wave 2's definition)

B.definition: delivered electricity (all industries) x PEF_ref / cumulative primary of this construction (Wave 2's definition)

C.definition: PEF_ref x cumulative delivered electricity / (fuels + PEF_ref x electricity + DH factor x district heat), all on construction C: numerator and denominator count electricity at the same factor

W2.definition: delivered electricity (all industries) x PEF_ref / cumulative primary of this construction (Wave 2's definition)

DST_ENE2MU2N_households.note: domestic closure, DST gross-energy basis. Its 'direct' term is not defined as ENE3H's household total, so it is a comparator, not a check

orientation_test.convention: A[i,j] = input from sector i per unit of output of sector j

truncation.definition: share = energy captured by supply-chain tiers 0..k of survival-category household final demand / complete boundary. B1 = share(0..1)/share(0..3); B3_measured = 1/share(0..3). Tier-0 household energy: see truncation() docstring (like-for-like with Wave 2)
